description: A skilled thief who steals secrets from inside people's dreams is offered a final job: plant an idea in a target's mind instead of taking one.
A banker sentenced to life in Shawshank State Penitentiary forms a lasting friendship with a fellow inmate and finds small ways to keep hope alive.
A struggling family schemes its way into the household of a wealthy one, until an unexpected discovery upsets the balance between them.
A ten-year-old girl wanders into a world of spirits and must work in a bathhouse for the gods to free her parents and find her way home.
Batman, Lieutenant Gordon and Harvey Dent take on the Joker, a criminal mastermind who pushes Gotham City toward chaos.
A shy Parisian waitress secretly sets out to improve the lives of the people around her, then has to decide whether to chase her own happiness.
In 1944 Spain, a young girl escapes the cruelty of her stepfather into a fairy-tale underworld where she is given three tasks to complete.
Two friends search for their long-lost college companion, recalling how his unconventional ideas about education changed the way they saw life.
With Earth's crops failing, a former pilot joins an expedition through a wormhole to find a new home for humanity.
A cable operator uses his love of cinema and careful planning to protect his family after an accident puts them under police suspicion.
In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel warrior race across the sands to free a tyrant's captives in one long, relentless chase.
Two teenagers who have never met begin swapping bodies in their sleep, and try to find each other across the distance between them.
